Today's quiz reviews for the final. It covers the whole course, with most of it on Topics 9 to 14: two samples, gains, ANOVA, correlation and regression. Bring a calculator, your notes and your questions.

We go over each answer as we go, and then there's time for your questions before the final. The quiz is worth 10 points, and being there earns the lab's 3 points (see the [syllabus](/syllabus.qmd#quizzes)).
